As a web and UX/UI designer, I have worked on several projects, including website redesign and UX/UI design. Notable projects include the redesign of the Children's Music School website and Pet-Saver-Hub, a web service for rescuing lost and found animals.

In the Children's Music School website redesign, I analyzed the existing website, identifying its strengths and weaknesses, and created a detailed wireframe of the new landing page. I designed a visually appealing and easy-to-navigate landing page, incorporating a news block and a prominent call to action, while ensuring consistency with the school's brand identity through careful selection of color scheme and typography. I prioritized user experience and ease of navigation, ensuring important information was easily accessible, and incorporated responsive design principles for a seamless user experience across devices.

For Pet-Saver-Hub, I conducted user research to identify key pain points and created a detailed user flow and wireframe, resulting in an intuitive and easy-to-navigate user interface. I incorporated interactive elements, such as a map feature, to facilitate the search process.

Through my experience, I have developed skills in wireframing, visual design, user research, and responsive design. I am committed to delivering high-quality work through maximum effort and value effective communication and teamwork, recognizing their importance in achieving results. I understand the crucial role of creativity and attention to detail in the design process and intend to actively engage with users, collecting feedback to improve the user experience.
